---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a schema, runner, or cache feature
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem does this solve

The Taskfile / build-pipeline pain you're trying to address. A
concrete repo or scenario beats abstract framing.

## Proposed change

What would the schema, CLI, or cache do differently? If it changes
the action-key inputs, call that out — cache compatibility matters.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you've thought about solving the problem (workarounds in
existing pkfire, switching to another runner, scripting around it).

## Schema or CLI sketch

If the change has a Pkl or CLI surface, sketch it. Doesn't have to
be final, just enough to discuss the shape.
